broadRun.note: returned under the 2000 cap -> effectively complete Firecrawl Map coverage of linear.app (subdomains excluded by policy)

scoutSample.method: deterministic bounded seed list derived from the broad discovery (data workaround, zero engine-code change): structural exclusions (workspace app permalinks, app shell, auth/oauth, non-HTML, _rsc probes) then per-first-segment sampling (group index always; members lexical-sorted, K=3 if group>=20, K=2 if >=5, else all). Full rule + per-URL detail in scout-sample-provenance.json
scoutSample.boundReasoning: spec recommends ~40-80 verified URLs; 107 candidates were verified because ~40 of them were depth-1 guess URLs from external links that only live verification could classify — they collapsed into one soft-404 duplicate family, leaving the genuinely distinct page count inside the recommended band

knownSourceInstability: soft-404s as HTTP 200: Linear serves its not-found page with status 200 and full HTML shell absence (11 elements); 23 of 107 sampled candidates were such pages — only fingerprint duplicate-grouping catches them (hard 404s also exist: /android, /ios returned real HTTP 404)
section rename drift: /blog and /blog/* permanently redirect to /now (renamed section); homepage footer still labels the /blog link 'Blog'
homepage promo drift: latest-changelog and customer-story promos on the homepage change over time (observed entries dated 2026-07/2026-08)
careers volatility: /careers?ashby_jid=<uuid> variants collapse to /careers by canonical+fingerprint; job postings will drift
cache-buster/probe queries in Firecrawl Map output: ?_bd=<timestamp> (docs), ?_rsc=<id> (Next.js RSC flight), synthetic external-guess URLs (/homepage /about-us /pricing-plans etc.)
no bot protection encountered: 114 verification fetches + 1 two-viewport deep observation with prepare-scroll all succeeded; 0 blocked, 0 navigation errors, no challenge pages

stability positive: / vs /homepage and /quality vs /quality/00 fetched minutes apart produced byte-identical text+structure fingerprints — no A/B variance observed in the sample (not exhaustively tested)
robots.txt (fetched read-only): disallows only /api/ and /cdn-cgi/ (Allow /api/og/); every route verified/observed here is allowed
toolingNotes: no CLI failed on Linear: pnpm recon, pnpm verify (x2), pnpm select, pnpm observe all completed with exit 0 and zero engine-code changes

scout-side data workaround (not an engine defect): the deterministic seed-list heuristic initially misclassified 7 nav-linked marketing routes (/coding-sessions /intake /diffs /monitor /asks /customer-requests /join-slack) as app-shell; corrected with a supplemental 7-URL verification run driven by homepage nav evidence

engine behavior worth knowing (by design, not a defect): pnpm select force-isolates the site root into its own family, so the /homepage alias remained a separate singleton family despite exact-fingerprint duplicate evidence; the Reconstruction-Builder must NOT treat /homepage as a distinct pilot page
pnpm select on this sample: 103 verified -> 65 families (36.9% reduction); low merge rate is expected at K<=3 members per URL family and does not indicate a selector defect
verdict: PILOT SCOPE DEFINED — 8 routes selected from observed evidence; READY FOR RECONSTRUCTION BUILDER
